agentGateway.title: Agent Gateway
agentGateway.description: Connect this Alfresco server to a NodeRef Agent Gateway for extra tools, prompts, and resources.
agentGateway.endpointHint: In Docker, localhost points at the backend container itself. Use host.docker.internal to reach a gateway on the host.
agentGateway.apiKeySavedPlaceholder: Key saved — leave empty to keep it
agentGateway.aclTitle: Tools are defined by the gateway
agentGateway.aclBody: The gateway decides which tools are available. SQL and index tools use backend accounts and do not follow Alfresco ACLs. Environment verification only covers the Alfresco passthrough route, not SQL or index backends.
agentGateway.verificationHint: Verification compares repository.id on the Alfresco passthrough route. SQL and index backends are not covered.
